problem: Personal AI agent apps are closed and tied to one company's models and cloud. OpenMausBot is a local-first chat app where you run a team of AI bots on your own machine.

stack.frontend: Vite-built chat app inside an Electron desktop app
stack.backend: TypeScript on Node.js 24+ with a local harness server on 127.0.0.1, managed with pnpm
stack.ai: Claude, Codex and Grok CLIs as agents, MCP server, Composio apps, computer-use with browsers and virtual machines
stack.deploy: Electron desktop installers (macOS, Windows, Ubuntu) and a Docker image with Caddy for self-hosting

whatsNew: Each bot is a real agent running your own installed CLI, with its own personality, model and Linux computer, shown like a messaging contact. Approval cards let you confirm risky actions.
